title: Join us for QGIS Open Day on 31 July 2026
content: On the last friday of every month we hold an online session for the QGIS Community. Presenters from around the world can share their experiences using QGIS for work and pleasure. We also have a regular 'what happened in QGIS this month?' session where you can catch up on the latest happenings in the project. See the link for the programme or subscribe to the QGIS YouTube channel for notifications.
